chunks: So keep yourself exclusively on the true way, the creational law of God according to which He created man with the quality of choosing right or wrong. There is no altering of God's creation. This is the supreme law. But most men do not understand.

key_terms.فِطْرَةَ اللَّهِ: The innate nature/disposition created by God

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Fitrah in Surah Ar-Rum?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, this verse is foundational for the doctrine of Fitrah, positing that the innate disposition toward monotheism is an intrinsic part of human creation rather than a mere cultural acquisition. The term 'Qayyim' (upright) is interpreted by Imams as referring to the religion of Islam in its pure, uncorrupted form, distinct from the deviations introduced by later communities. This highlights the theological principle that recognizing one's true nature is synonymous with recognizing God, a concept deeply linked to the concept of Imamate as the guide who reveals this innate truth.
